message.content:
**Pantone “Sky Blue”**

The most widely referenced Pantone color that matches the classic “sky blue” hue is:

| Pantone Code | Name | Notes |
|--------------|------|-------|
| **Pantone 14‑4318** | Sky Blue | This is the standard Pantone “Sky Blue” used in many design and printing applications. It’s a bright, mid‑tone blue that closely resembles the color of a clear daytime sky. |

If you need a slightly different shade (e.g., a lighter or darker sky blue), Pantone offers several related options:

| Pantone Code | Shade | Description |
|--------------|-------|-------------|
| **Pantone 14‑4317** | Light Sky Blue | A softer, lighter version of the standard sky blue. |
| **Pantone 14‑4319** | Dark Sky Blue | A deeper, richer blue that still retains the “sky” feel. |
| **Pantone 15‑4515** | Sky Blue (Pantone 15‑4515) | A slightly more saturated, modern take on sky blue. |

When specifying a Pantone color for print or digital work, it’s always a good idea to provide the exact Pantone code (e.g., “Pantone 14‑4318”) so the printer or designer can match it precisely.
